title: No route writes an `advisory` log entry, and its `versions` range has no syntax.
text: An owner can retract a version but cannot announce an advisory over a range of versions. Closing it writes the range's syntax, a route that takes it from a token and waits seven days or from a passkey and takes effect at once, the `advisory` entry in the feed, and `nvs pkg audit` reading it (`rule:packaging/a-known-bad-version-is-retracted-not-deleted`).
